title: America and the World Will Pay Reparations

sense.text:
Before we get to the white man, we deal with us first: the Israelites, that’s blacks, Latinos and Native American Indians. Not the fake five dollar Indians who make believe they’re American Indians.

“We have made a covenant with death”: the death the Bible is making reference to is Esau Edom. Write that down, he is the death. Covenant means agreement. Some of our people, male and female, have made an agreement with this white man, with death; it’s a metaphor for the white man. “And with hell are we at agreement”: our people are complicit with the low state we’re in. We’re all equal, all races are equal? You really believe that? Anytime you think of cultural success you don’t think of black people, Latinos, Native Americans; you think of Caucasians, you might even think of Chinese and Arabs, but we’re always on the bottom of the list.

“When the overflowing scourge shall pass through”, meaning when destruction passes through, “it shall not come unto us”: nothing gonna happen to us. “For we have made lies our refuge”: we have believed the lies of death, the white man; we believe everything this white man has told us and think we gonna be safe. “And under falsehood have we hid ourselves”: hiding ourselves under the lies of democracy, the lies of Christianity, the lies of republicanism. We’ve covered ourselves with that.

“Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation”: Christ is that stone. “He that believeth shall not make haste”: to make haste means to run from this truth. He that believes is gonna stay with the stone, the rock of his salvation.
“The refuge of lies”: destruction shall sweep away the refuge of lies. “And the waters shall overflow the hiding place”: the waters is God’s law, and it shall overflow the hiding places in your lies.

You men and women listen good: “your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand”. Your agreement with hell that we stay in this low condition shall not stand. You brothers and sisters that have made an agreement with society that we stay in this low state, this low condition, the Bible prophesies “ye shall be trodden down by it.”

“From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you”: from the time it happens, because we’re prophesying it is going to happen. “And it shall be a vexation only to understand the report”: when you hear this Bible now it’s going to be a vexation to your soul, to your spirit, because you’re going to know what’s really going on in this world, in society.

precepts.why:
Just to show you who that death is. “And I looked, and behold a pale horse”: this pale horse represents sickness, disease. This whole chapter deals with Esau Edom. “And his name that sat on him was Death”: this him which is death is Esau Edom. “And Hell followed with him”: the lowest state of hell followed this man that sat on this pale horse. It’s all a metaphor.

“And power was given unto them”: notice it went from him to them. That them is that him which is death and hell. “Over the fourth part of the earth”: the fourth part of the earth is America. “To kill with sword”: that’s war. “And with hunger”: that’s famine. “And with death”: that’s death is what it is. “And with the beasts of the earth”: that’s disease. It’s called zoonoses, when they splice animal genes with human genes and make diseases.

So the death Israel made a covenant with in Isaiah 28:15 is the same him that sat on the pale horse, and hell followed with him.

To explain the hell we’re at agreement with. “Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge”: no knowledge of God’s laws. “And their honourable men are famished”: famished from knowing God’s truth. “And their multitude dried up with thirst”: the multitudes of our people don’t know God’s truth, his laws either.

“Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure”: hell is the lowest state, and it means there’s stages, there’s levels. When we think about hell we think about slavery. We got released from slavery, but we were mentally destroyed. And it ain’t just that: as a whole, not the one or two of you that got some money on the side, we are financially in hell, we are mentally in hell, we are spiritually in hell. We don’t even know our nationality. Our families are destroyed; that’s another form of hell. So this hell includes a litany of things: slavery, physical, mental, spiritual degradation, poverty, lack of education, bad health. Hell hath enlarged herself: it’s gotten worse and worse over time.

“And their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it”: all of our people that rejoice have descended into hell.

Put verse 13 with verse 14 and it’s telling you that hell is captivity, in its various states. People are quick to say I’m not in captivity, I’m free. Like Jason Whitlock: he was on the show saying I’m free; he makes maybe 10 million dollars a year, but according to the word of God he don’t know who he is, he don’t know what race he comes from, and the nation of people around him are destitute, impoverished. And he’s like no, but I’m free, white folks love me. No bro, you don’t rise above the status of your people. You’re in captivity right along with the rest of us.

An example. “Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.” Christ does many miracles; remember Christ is the stone, the rock that we just read about in Isaiah 28:16. “If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him”: if we don’t do something about him, everybody’s going to believe on him.

“And the Romans shall come”: the Romans is the so-called white man. He’s the death that we just read about in Isaiah 28. “And take away both our place and nation”: our placement, our positions in society. Some of you got good jobs, good employment; you congressmen, congresswomen, senators, pastors, preachers, law enforcement; you get paid very, very well to do what you do. That’s the place you’re afraid the Romans will take away, so you stay in your covenant with death.

sense.text: I’m building somewhere; I’m still dealing with us right now. “Nation shall rise against nation”: we see that now with Ukraine, with Russia, with America giving the Ukraine weapons, with Turkey assisting Russia. “And kingdom against kingdom”.

“And great earthquakes shall be in divers places”: we’re seeing that right now in Turkey and in Syria. “And famines”: we’re seeing that. “And pestilences”: disease, covid-19 and so forth. “And fearful sights”: the fearful sights go into what they call the UFOs, but they are identifiable. “And great signs”, like blood moons, “shall there be from heaven.”

“But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you”: this is what I want you brothers and sisters to understand: it’s not going to be a walk in the park in this truth. “And persecute you”: you men and women that believe and understand that you’re Israelites. “Delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons”: they gonna deliver us up to their synagogues and into prison. They arrested Andrew Tate and they extended his jail sentence. He ain’t in the truth, not yet, but they want to break his spirit, like they broke the spirit of Nelson Mandela when they put him in prison. That’s their goal. “Being brought before kings and rulers for my name’s sake.”

“And it shall turn to you for a testimony”: Christ said don’t worry about that, that’s going to be your time to testify. The testimony the Lord is looking for ain’t your testimony about how you came into the truth; he don’t want to hear that. You’re going to testify the words of God on this day that he’s prophesying about.

“Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer”: you ain’t got to write nothing down, don’t worry about it. “For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist”: no one’s going to be able to gainsay the words that we speak on that day, when we give the testimony of the Lord of heaven and earth.

“And ye shall be betrayed both by parents”: some of your parents gonna betray you. “And brethren”: your brothers are going to betray you. “And kinsfolks”: your kinsfolk that you love so dearly. Bishop, can you pray for my mama, can you pray for my cousin Ed? Your mom and your cousin Ed gonna betray you one day if they don’t repent. “And friends”. “And some of you shall they cause to be put to death”: it don’t say all of you, it says some of you. Just expect it.

“And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake”: that hatred starts with these campaigns they are putting out. The ADL, the SPLC are putting out campaigns of what they term hate speech. They’re building it, building it to get all nations against the word of God. That’s their agenda.

Still dealing with our people. “For there be many that perish in this life, because they despise the law of God that is set before them”. All of you brothers and sisters understand: if you don’t have a love for the Most High’s laws, you better pray for that spirit.

“Strait commandment”: narrow commandments. “What they should do to live, even as they came, and what they should observe to avoid punishment”: the Lord has given us laws; he said you keep these laws, that’s how you avoid punishment. You want to avoid the lake of fire, keep God’s laws. You got people out there saying to avoid punishment don’t take a chip. That’s not what the Bible’s talking about. To avoid eternal judgment, eternal damnation, God says keep my commandments.

“Nevertheless they were not obedient unto him; but spake against him, and imagined vain things”. Some of you imagine it ain’t so much about God’s laws: all you talk about is the law; it ain’t that, brothers, it’s the microchip. Let that be a lesson to you. I’m not saying they’re not trying to create stupidity like that, but if we want to escape eternal damnation the Bible says keep the laws.

“And deceived themselves by their wicked deeds”: some Israelites say you can buy prostitutes, it don’t matter with God; you could be homosexual, a lesbian, it don’t matter, just don’t take the chip and you okay. That’s not in the Bible; some of y’all crazy out there. “And said of the most High, that he is not; and knew not his ways”: the white man does that particularly, but you got some of our people that do that too.

“But his law have they despised”: that’s the root of it. When you hear people say to hell with that, you better mark them and stay away from them. “And denied his covenants; in his statutes have they not been faithful, and have not performed his works.”

precepts.why:
“For when they had taken liberty, they despised the most High”: we got liberty, we ain’t in shackles and chains no more; we got free. We’re only free from physical chains. “Thought scorn of his law, and forsook his ways”: that’s our people right there.

“Moreover they have trodden down his righteous”: his righteous people. “And said in their heart, that there is no God”: they doubt his existence. “Yea, and that knowing they must die”: that is not a question; they must die, that’s what the Bible says. Despising the law of God set before them is why many perish in this life.

“And they that have lothed my law”: the word loathe means hate. “While they had yet liberty”: you had liberty to repent. “And, when as yet place of repentance was open unto them”: that’s what the brothers on the street teaching is all about; that’s what these videos of teaching are all about, a place of repentance. “Understood not, but despised it”.

“The same must know it after death by pain.” There is pain after death for those spirits that reject and hate God’s law. Y’all keep on playing.

sense.text: I’m still dealing with us, dealing with our people. “Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come”: the Lord is prophesied to come, and you don’t know the hour.

This is a parable, an illustrated story. The good man of the house in this parable is Esau; the good man of the house is Rome. “If the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come”: who’s the thief? Christ is the thief. If America knew what time and hour Christ would come, “he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.” But no man knows the day or the hour, so the white man don’t know.

“Therefore be ye also ready”: Christ says to us now, be ye ready; keep the commandments and live. “For in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh”: when you don’t think the Lord’s coming, that’s when he’s coming. It’s going to be the brink of destruction; it’s gonna seem like the Lord forgot about us. He said don’t worry, I’m gonna beat him; when you least expect it, I’m there.

precepts.why: A precept for who the good man of the house is. “That they may possess the remnant of Edom”: who’s Edom? The so-called white man, Esau, Rome. “And of all the heathen, which are called by my name”: those names are Jews and Christians. They’re heathen; they call themselves Jews and Christians. That’s the house Christ is coming to break up.

Why is he called good, the good man of the house? “Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies”: this man, our enemy, would give us food; he would control the food industry. “In hunger, and in thirst”: he would own and run the water industry; that’s how we would get our water. “And in nakedness”: he will control the clothing, the textile industry; we have to go to him for clothing. “And in want of all things”: education, religion, science, medicine, whatever it is, you got to go to your enemy. Your enemy would provide for you; he would be somewhat good to you.

“And he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck”: that’s how you identify him. He would put a yoke of iron on our neck, until he have destroyed us.

The precept for being nourished by your enemy. “And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle”: the woman represents the nation of Israel; we fled from Rome, that’s the two wings of a great eagle. “That she might fly into the wilderness”: we fled into Africa, that’s the wilderness. “Into her place”: into our places, America.

“Where she is nourished”: provided for, food, water, clothing, want of all things. “For a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent”: the serpent, which is our enemy, would nourish us with food, water, clothing, want of all things, education, religion, medicine, security, homes and houses, welfare, public assistance. All that’s from our enemies. That is why the good man of the house is called good.

Christ is the thief; let’s see what he’s gonna steal. Remember this is a parable, an illustrated story. “I will send him against an hypocritical nation”: God said he would send him against a hypocritical nation. “And against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey”: when the Lord returns he’s going to take the spoil and take the prey. Guess who the spoil and the prey is: Israel. He’s going to deliver us. “And to tread them down like the mire of the streets.”

This is the answer here. “Shall the prey be taken from the mighty”: we are the prey; who’s the mighty? The so-called white man. “Or the lawful captive delivered?” We’re the lawful captive. Why is it lawful for us to be captive? Because we broke God’s laws.

“But thus saith the Lord, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away”: no matter how mighty America is, the Bible prophesies we shall be taken away. “And the prey of the terrible shall be delivered”: we are the prey of the terrible, and we’re going to be delivered.

“For I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.” So we ain’t got to worry, we ain’t gotta fuss, we ain’t gotta fight. The Lord said don’t worry, the battle is mine; I’m gonna contend with the nations that contend with you, I got this. That’s the thief breaking up the good man’s house.

sense.text:
“Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan”: that’s the him that sat on the horse that was called Death, that we read about in Revelation 6, that we read about in Isaiah 28. The Bible uses metaphors to talk about the same thing. Remember who would nourish us: we would be nourished from the face of the serpent, and now it says him whose coming is after the working of Satan.

“With all power”: this man would have all power, seemingly. “And signs”: signs that he’s of God, but it’s only signs that he’s of Satan. “And lying wonders”: his signs, his power, his religion, his medicine are lying wonders. How many of you have read the book Medical Apartheid? All the achievements of medicine that they got, they experimented on the slaves; thousands of us died in the process. Oh, the white man’s medicine is such a wonder. No, we died and died and died.

This is him that has all power and signs and lying wonders today. The Southern Poverty Law Center has all the IUIC schools and their locations on their website. It’s not just to identify them; it’s done for a more insidious reason, for some person to do us harm. The black men and black women among them, there’s hope for them to repent; why don’t you sit down and talk with us and stop being guided by Amalek? Our people among them have seemingly made a covenant with death, and with hell are they at agreement. These are the ones that sat in their war room and said put the addresses of where their schools are. The Lord got all of you marked.

The Anti-Defamation League also has us pinned as hateful; they keep saying we have murdered people, we have spray-painted swastikas. That’s all lies. Their board is all Amalek, all so-called Jewish people, every last one of them, and they say we’re for justice of all mankind. Why lie, then? You put that out there so that somebody can do us harm, and so that our people won’t come to us to learn who they are and repent. There’s layers to the reason that they lie on us.

Then there’s Canary Mission, with a list of students, professors, professionals and organizations that are allegedly anti-Semitic. If you have said anything against Amalek, they put you on there, and that’s to get you terminated from your job; they got some kicked out of college, their scholarships revoked. I said years ago in class, don’t use your real name on those social media platforms; if you have a prestigious job or position, don’t have a social media page. Some of you women can’t stay off Facebook: here’s my husband, you circle his face, he works there. They went to his job, called his bosses and got him terminated. Facebook was not meant for us; it was meant to monitor us. You brothers that have high paying jobs, you don’t need to be on the front line; just fall back, we got you.

They say you’re racist. What can we say or do to get you imprisoned, arrested, shot by the police? Nothing. We don’t have power to be racist. These so-called Jewish people have the power, the resources, the influence to get you terminated, shot by the police, arrested. They are the real racists. When I speak I’m not lying; I’m giving you evidence, proof of what these people do. A brother quoted scripture on Twitter and they call it anti-Semitism; so they’re saying the Bible is anti-Semitism. They don’t believe in the Bible at all; when they tell you America is a Christian nation, it’s all garbage. They collect the data and they’re going to use it against us when it’s time. You’re going to be on God’s side or Satan’s side; this ain’t no in the middle. Some of y’all worked for the sheriff’s department, the FBI, the CIA, the health profession, and got terminated. This war is real, the fight is real, and these people are the enemies of God.

“And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness”: all deceit of unrighteousness, sin. This man would deceive us with sin. “In them that perish”: them destined to perish. “Because they received not the love of the truth”: because you received not God’s laws and commandments. “That they might be saved”: that you might be saved, brothers; that you might be saved, sisters.

“And for this cause”: for this reason, because you reject the commandments, “God shall send them strong delusion”: you’re going to believe everything this white man tells you. “That they should believe a lie”: you’re gonna believe every lie he’s told you.

“That they all might be damned”: that’s eternal damnation, that’s the lake of fire. “Who believed not the truth”: because you didn’t want to keep God’s laws, his commandments, your fate is sealed. “But had pleasure in unrighteousness”: you had pleasure in sin. Be what you want to be, do what you want to do. That’s you making a covenant with death and hell. This is saying the same thing we read in Isaiah 28:15 and in Revelation chapter 6: it’s when our people make an agreement with this white man.

precepts.why: Back to the one that sat on the horse. “And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him.” His name that sat on the horse was called Death, and hell followed: that’s a metaphor. Second Thessalonians 2:9 is talking about the same thing: him whose coming is after the working of Satan is that him that sat on the pale horse, the death our people made a covenant with in Isaiah 28.

sense.text: The war is real, and these people are the enemies of God. The book of Job is symbolic: Job represents the nation of Israel in a low state, trying to come out of the low squalor that he was put in, which we are in. He has councilmen around him, and the spirit is amongst them as they are speaking; the spirit goes from Job to his friends. His friends was going off, but the things that they speak about, many of them reflect on us today.

“I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.” We’ve heard the check of our reproach. Our reproach is they say we’re not the Jews; we are Gentiles, we’re African-Americans, we’re Latinos, Native Americans, we ain’t nobody. So the spirit of my understanding causes me to answer.

“Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth, That the triumphing of the wicked is short”: this white man’s triumphing is only going to be for a short time. “And the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment”: they are the hypocrite. Why does it call them the hypocrite? Because they say and claim that they’re Jews, Jewish and Christian; they say America is a Christian society, but they do everything contrary to what the word of God says.

The ex-Canary members: to get off of their list you must apologize, you must go through counseling, like Nick Cannon. That’s the only way they take you off. These people are the wicked the Bible speaks of.

The so-called Jewish people, Amalek, Esau, Edom, whatever you want to call them, were on both sides during the Civil War, 1861 to 1865. It was the North against the South, a battle to either keep us enslaved or release the slaves, and so-called Jewish people were in the Confederate Army. And look at America’s largest hate groups, from your friends that say they’re about love and freedom: they have Israel United in Christ number three, and the Nation of Islam number two, and the Nation of Islam hasn’t even been active doing anything. Way down at the bottom of the list, number 20, the American Christian Dixie Knights of the Ku Klux Klan. Y’all don’t see any disparity with that? That’s so people will do us harm and not these Caucasians. I hope y’all see the plot, the plan, how it thickens.

precepts.why:
The wicked. “Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places”: they rebuilt from the Renaissance era. “Thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down”: they shall build, but God will throw down. “And they shall call them, The border of wickedness”.

Edom, which is the biblical name for all Caucasians, is the border of wickedness. So the wicked whose triumphing is short in Job 20:5 is Edom.

“For every battle of the warrior is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood”: for example the Civil War, the Civil War was like that. “But this shall be with burning and fuel of fire”: what is about to come on earth shall be with burning and fuel of fire, talking about missile, thermonuclear destruction, thus saith the Lord. That is how the triumphing of the wicked is cut short.

And the so-called Jewish people love to lie: anytime something bad happens they say they were not around. Slavery? We didn’t exist. The Civil War? We weren’t there. But then they have books like The Jewish Confederates, by a so-called Jew, and you won’t find books like this in the African-American section. Jewish Confederates fought for what they termed their liberty and freedom, which included the right to own slaves. Jewish people owned slaves; don’t ever let them fool you. Even those who owned no slaves had a stake in the South’s racial caste system: we don’t want these to be equal with us, they need to know their place, on the bottom, beneath my boot. That’s what they wanted. They fought to keep us as slaves.

sense.text: “Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds”: this is still talking about the wicked, the triumphing of the wicked from verse 5.

“Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung”: the Bible prophesied it. Like doo-doo, like when you flush crap down the toilet; that’s what God says.

“They which have seen him shall say, Where is he?” They’re going to ask that question when the Most High wipes them off the earth. Again, this is not any racist rhetoric; we are reading the Bible, we’re reading what the Bible says. He’s going to be nonexistent; he’s not going to be a factor in the earth anymore.

“He shall fly away as a dream”: this white man that has ruled the earth is going to be like a bad dream; that’s what God says right here. “And shall not be found”: he shall not be found no more.

“Yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.” You know what a vision of the night is? A nightmare. He’s going to be like a nightmare you wake up out of: had a dream that the white man had us shackled and chained, put COVID-19 on us, and it never happened. That’s what the Bible prophesies is going to happen.

“Neither shall his place any more behold him”: he ain’t going to have America, he ain’t going to have France, he ain’t going to have Germany, Britain, Europe, South Africa, Australia. He got nothing; he’s going to be gone.

“His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.” I told you they’re going to pay reparations. Everything they took from us, the Bible prophesies they shall restore it.

precepts.why:
Who is it whose excellency mounts up to the heavens? “For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God”: this is them, putting a nest among the stars of God. Space travel.

“I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north”: that’s enslaving us in North America.

“I will ascend above the heights of the clouds”: airplanes, and there’s space travel; that is what it means. “I will be like the most High”: I’ll be like God, that’s what they’re saying. That is his head reaching unto the clouds in Job 20:6.

He shall fly away as a dream. “When the Lord turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream”: when he turns our captivity away from us. “Then was our mouth filled with laughter”: I just had a dream, man, that was just a freaking nightmare; what a nightmare that was, well, I’m glad that didn’t happen. “And our tongue with singing”: we’re going to sing, we’re going to laugh on that day.

All that we got right here, with all that we see that our ancestors have experienced, is going to be like a dream of the night, like a freaking nightmare, when we wake up and we’re in a kingdom. God said it’s going to be like it never happened.

This is what it means when it says his hands shall restore their goods. “Thus saith the Lord God, Behold, I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles”: that’s you. “And set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring thy sons in their arms, and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.” Believe it or not, there are sons and daughters that we don’t know about. The leadership sits down and goes through the history to try to figure out where Israel is located, and there’s some people we ain’t going to know. The Lord said don’t worry, just do what y’all can, I got the rest, after the destruction, the Bible prophesies.

They’re going to get an ultimatum to return every Israelite that’s scattered throughout the diaspora. These nations are going to carry our sons and our daughters to us, paying homage to us.

“And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth”: when they return our sons and daughters they’re going to be like, here’s your people, and they’re going to bow down to us. “And lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.” Those of you men and women that stay in this truth, you will not be ashamed; but those that get scared and leave, you’re going to be ashamed. The rest of us are not going to be ashamed on that day.

sense.text:
“His bones are full of the sin of his youth.” Who is it talking about? Edom, Esau. The same wicked we read about in verse 5, the same hypocrite we read about in verse 5, the same man whose excellency mounts up to the heavens and whose head reaches to the clouds.

The sin of his youth means from way back. Not just 1776; you can’t start there, you got to go way back, to Cain. “Which shall lie down with him in the dust.”

precepts.why:
The sins of his youth. “If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted?” That’s what God said to Cain: if you do well you will be accepted, meaning if you keep the commandments I’ll accept you, Cain. “And if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door”: if you break my commandments, Cain, sin, disobedience, lies at the door.

“And unto thee shall be his desire”: unto you, Satan, shall be Cain’s desire, meaning Satan’s going to be Cain’s daddy. That’s the sins of his youth. “And thou shalt rule over him”: Satan, you shall rule over Cain.

“Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him”: he killed his brother Abel. “And the Lord said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother’s keeper?” He lies; he lies to the Most High.

“What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother’s blood crieth unto me from the ground.” You know why his brother’s blood was crying? Because in the spirit realm you never die. The righteous never die.

Here’s the precept for why Abel’s voice was crying to the Lord. “I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God”: slain for keeping the commandments, like Abel was slain for keeping the commandments. “And for the testimony which they held.”

“And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?” That was the slain, the rest of us, disciples and prophets, crying to the Lord, just as the voice of Abel’s blood cried from the ground.

Christ speaks of the blood of Abel. “That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.” All the blood from the time of Cain and Abel is going to be judged on this wicked generation; it’s going to be judged on America. That is the sin of his youth lying down with him.

Still dealing with his bones being full of the sin of his youth. This is Christ speaking to the Pharisees, and the Pharisees were Israelites. “Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do.”

“He was a murderer from the beginning”: he’s telling the Pharisees, you’re like Cain, you men are just like Cain, who followed Satan his daddy. Your daddy was a murderer from the beginning; he murdered his brother, and you’re following that example.

“And abode not in the truth”: Cain did not abide in the laws of God. “Because there is no truth in him”: there’s no truth in Cain, because Satan became his father. Cain, in the regeneration, came back as Esau.

“In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil”: a distinction is made between the children of God and the children of the devil. “Whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God”: any one of you men or women that don’t keep the commandments, you’re not of God, “neither he that loveth not his brother.”

“For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another”: we were commanded to love one another. “Not as Cain”: not the love that Cain had, that hypocritical love, that hateful love, that murderous love. “Who was of that wicked one”: who was of the devil, “and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil”: because he did not want to keep the commandments, “and his brother’s righteous.” That was our story.

“Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.” Brothers and sisters, don’t be shocked if the world hates you; that’s the message John gives us today.

“We know that we have passed from death unto life”: this whole life is death, and we have passed from this to life, meaning eternal life, New Jerusalem, “because we love the brethren.” “He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.” So sisters, if you got any issues with your husband or your friend in this truth, and brothers, the same for you if you got issues with your wife: if you have a spirit of hatred, hatred towards one another, you’re abiding in death. If you have hate for the other Israelite camps, you are abiding in death. The Bible says be angry, but sin not.

“Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer”: yeah, you’re a murderer. “And ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.”

sense.text: “Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue”: the white man will never come out, the majority of them won’t come out, and say I hate you, I can’t stand you, I wish you dead. They don’t do that; they hide it under the tongue.
“Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth”: it’s still in his mouth.

“Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.” The asp is one of the most poisonous snakes on the earth. That’s his philosophies, his doctrines.

Never trust your enemy, because they will hide information from us. Their own people wrote old books, like one on the regions of Africa, to their own people. In it, the religion of the Inland Negroes, in what they called Negro land in Africa: our people anciently worshiped one God, the Lord of Heaven (remember, we spoke another language), the acknowledgment of a deity infinitely supreme governing all. That’s talking about the Most High God.

After this ‘they were instructed in the Mosaic law, which they long and zealously observed.’ See, they won’t tell you this in school, that in Negro land in Africa many of us were observing the Mosaic law. They keep that information for themselves. They said no, you were running around with grass skirts going ‘Uncle Bunga’ and throwing spears.

Then some were converted to the Christian faith, which eclipsed the Jewish: we got proselytized from keeping the commandments to Christianity. Then Mohammedism, talking about Islam, overspread, and they fell into apostasy, drinking in the poison of this new infection. Christianity is a point of the apostasy as well. But the southern people that inhabit the coast from Cape Verde to the kingdom of Loango stuck to their first tenet, the Mosaic laws. Some of our people in Africa were still keeping God’s law, and they keep this from us in school.

precepts.why:
“Never trust thine enemy”: the Bible says never trust your enemies. “For like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness”: you have a good piece of iron, and the same way it will rust in time, that’s how their wickedness is.

“Though he humble himself”: though he say I’m sorry for what my ancestors did, I love black people, I love you Latinos too, Latinx, I love you Native Americans, I apologize for what was done. “And go crouching”: some Israelites say bow down to me, and they bow, and they go, the white man bowed to me. You simple as hell, Israelites.

“Yet take good heed and beware of him”: the Bible says take heed of him and beware of him. “And thou shalt be unto him as if thou hadst wiped a lookingglass”: it’s like when you get out the shower and the mirror is all fogged up; you wipe it and now you can see clear. The Bible says you do that with him. Don’t worry about him kissing your feet in this kingdom; he didn’t change. He’s deceiving every Israelite that he bows to right now, because he’s thinking, concocting some evil plan; that’s what the Bible is saying.

“And thou shalt know that his rust hath not been altogether wiped away”: his wickedness ain’t gone, though he humbled himself to you, crouched down to you and kissed your boot. The only time he’s going to be sincere is when we get that power; right now he’s playing you for a fool. Our elders at the old school didn’t do that; you got this young group doing it.

The only time he’s going to be sincere: “Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.” That’s a future prophecy; it has not come to pass yet. Until then the wickedness is still sweet in his mouth, hid under his tongue.

“To deliver thee from the way of the evil man”: the Lord’s plan is to deliver us from the way of the evil man, “from the man that speaketh froward things.” Froward and forward are two different words: froward, f-r-o-w-a-r-d, means rebellious; forward, f-o-r-w-a-r-d, means forward thinking.

“Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness; Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked”: they delight in the rebellion, the rebelliousness of the wicked; they love that thing. Look at Dwyane Wade: the court allowed his child a legal name change and recognized the transition from male to female. That’s a man-child, that’s a boy, he got a ding-a-ling. You can’t make this stuff up.

“Whose ways are crooked”: their ways are crooked, the ways of this world are crooked, “and they froward in their paths.”

sense.text:
Here’s another book written by Amalek, on the Jews and Moors in Spain. It tells of a Roman Catholic periodical published in Barcelona, Spain, on July 29, 1883, whose writer imagined the burning stake a thing of the near future: ‘the establishment of the Holy tribunal of the Inquisition must soon take place’, and ‘the number of those who will be called to suffer under it will exceed the number of the past.’ This was after the Inquisition; that’s why the one writing the book says he sounds like he’s talking about a future event soon to come to pass. Some Catholic diocese knows what’s going to happen, and the majority, especially our people, don’t know. They’re telling you there’s going to be another Inquisition. Y’all keep on playing dumb; you better wake up.

“For there shall be in every place, and in the next cities, a great insurrection upon those that fear the Lord”: that’s what the ADL is about, the SPLC, the Canary Mission.

“They shall be like mad men, sparing none, but still spoiling and destroying those that fear the Lord.”

Where did the Klansmen get their hoods and ideas from? From Spain. Many of them were conversos that came from Spain to America before it was called America, around 1776; prior to that you had the Spanish here, the French here, the English here, everybody fighting. The idea of the dress code came from the pointed hood of Spain, and you see how they got the cross. In Spain they still have parades like this, a celebration of what happened during the Inquisition; these are Christians. Some books will say those that confessed their alleged sins wore a conical hat, but they didn’t cover their face; why would the sinners have to cover their face? It was those doing the execution that covered their faces.

You’re going to tell me the KKK didn’t get their concept from that? When the Spanish came over here to America they brought this with them, and changed their names to Billy Bob and things like that. Put the KKK in the middle: the uniforms are the same, the cross bearing and all. You can fool some of the people some of the time, but you ain’t fooling God or his people.

“He hath swallowed down riches”: he robbed everybody. “And he shall vomit them up again”: the riches he stole, he shall vomit them up again. “God shall cast them out of his belly”: God shall cast the riches that he swallowed down, that he stole, out of his belly.

precepts.why: “Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him.” The Most High God said his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him. It don’t matter if you marry him or her, or you have kids with them; the Bible says his soul is not upright. His soul is crooked. God made them that way.

How he swallowed down riches. “Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee”: why is this white man wiser than Daniel, and why is there no secret they can hide from him? It goes into their technology, their technological advances. They do have agents among all of the IUIC camps and the other camps and the Nation of Islam, but they really don’t need them: these phones, these smart TVs record and transmit everywhere. And some of your wives are better than the agents. They broadcast everything on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, TikTok: your images, your name, some of them where you live, your whole house, how many kids you got, your newborn babies. Your wives are better agents than the agents themselves; they’re their own worst enemies, and some of your brothers too.

“With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures”: that goes with the IMF, their World Bank, the banking system. They go steal resources, and then the IMF says your money’s no good. Although you do have the natural resources, your gold means nothing, your dollar value is minimal compared to ours. That’s what they do.

“By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches”: traffick means trade and commerce. “And thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches.”

“The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet”: all of these items come from the continent of Africa. “And slaves”: how could we forget? The beginning of their economy was the slave trade. Who benefited from the slave trade? The federal banks, the military, the school system, the textile companies; all of these institutions and companies got their beginning with the transatlantic slave trade. “And souls of men”: that’s when they got us into Christianity, to bow down to them and worship them.

This is by their great wisdom and their traffick. We were the cargo trafficked from state to state, country to country. The cotton, the textiles: they got rich and famous behind that, and it was our mothers and fathers that picked it. Even the gold and the diamonds: guess who’s going into the earth to dig it up? Our people; it ain’t the white man going in there.

Write this down: 424 years of free labor and colonialism, from 1441 to 1865. A hundred percent profit for 424 years, every day. Not only that, they stole lands: they stole America, they stole South Africa, they stole Australia. The churches prospered off of that, the Vatican, the Catholics, and the Protestant institutions as well; the Vatican was built by the hands of slaves, free slave labor. The banking institutions of the 1700s and 1800s got started on the backs of 424 years of free slave labor. Don’t let them think it was just the southern whites that benefited.

In the movie Inside Man they had wealth from Germany in there; what they didn’t tell you is that the blacks in there was us, the black Jews they slaughtered and killed and cast out. They took everything we had. The federal government, federal, state and local governments, the insurance companies, they all benefited from the transatlantic slave trade, and then they go, we don’t have any money. Don’t let nobody fool you and say no they didn’t; we just read it in Ezekiel 28:3-5 and Revelation 18.

The shipping companies: big money, all of it founded on the slave trade. Don’t let nobody fool you that only the southern white plantation owners got money; that’s a damn lie, and the Bible says they’re a bunch of damn liars, every last one of them. The learning institutions: Harvard, built by slaves, founded by slave money, financed by the slave trade; you talk about no slaves being involved in that? Are you stupid? Yale University was built in 1701; where were we? Slavery. You think white folks built that? They didn’t build a damn thing; pick up them bricks. Princeton, built in 1746: I feel like I’m back in Egypt, making bricks without straw. The University of Virginia, built in 1819. All they do is lie, lie, lie. The land they built these prestigious universities on was stolen property, and they used slaves to build and maintain their buildings and to teach white supremacy doctrines.

sense.text: Back to Job 20 at verse 15: “He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.” From 15 down it’s all going into them restoring what they stole: reparations. Then “He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper’s tongue shall slay him.”

“He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.” Meaning he ain’t gonna see the kingdom; he’s not going to enjoy the kingdom.

Honey is from bees, butter is from cows’ milk. Milk and honey goes with the animals and the insects, where you get good vegetation: that’s the kingdom. They’re not going to enjoy it.

“That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down”: he ain’t gonna swallow it down to enjoy it. “According to his substance shall the restitution be.”

Put restitution on the screen and look at the synonyms: return, restoration, handing back, replacement, surrender, yielding, compensation, recompense, reparation. That’s what restitution means: reparation. They say we don’t have any money, but guess what, Mr. white man, you gonna pay. America gonna pay reparations, Australia gonna pay reparations, Germany gonna pay reparations, South Africa gonna pay reparations. All of you gonna pay reparations, saith the Lord.

“And he shall not rejoice therein”: he ain’t gonna be happy about it either, and the Lord don’t give a damn if he ain’t happy.

“Therefore thy gates shall be open continually”: our gates, brothers, our gates, sisters, are going to be open continually. “They shall not be shut day nor night”, and he explains why: “that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles”. The forces of the Gentiles is their wealth, the wealth that they stole, that they swallowed. They gonna vomit it all up again, and they’re going to bring it to us in New Jerusalem.

“And that their kings may be brought”: their kings going to be brought. That’s why Job 20 says they’re not going to be happy; they ain’t going to rejoice, because their kings gonna be brought.
“For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish”: that’s for anybody that does not obey. They shall perish; that’s Bible prophecy. “Yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.”

“The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee”. We read about Lebanon in the news; Lebanon is going to bring their wealth to New Jerusalem. “The fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary”: so the foundation’s going to be laid, the beautiful wood is laid.

“And I will make the place of my feet glorious”: stress the I. The Most High is going to do something himself, and that’s what we read in Revelation 21.

“The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee”: this goes with Revelation 3:9. So when you see the white man kiss your boot today, that means nothing, because the white man’s evil is still there. He’s still plotting, he’s still planning. But here, all that’s going to change. “And all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of the Lord, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.”

“Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated”: we as a people have been forsaken and hated here in society, “so that no man went through thee”: nobody want to deal with us. “I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.”

“Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles”: all their wealth. “And shalt suck the breast of kings”: everything the kings got, we gonna take. “And thou shalt know that I the Lord am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.”

“For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make thy officers peace, and thine exactors righteousness.” Exactors means tax collectors. We’re going to collect taxes from all nations. That’s when you know you’re free.

precepts.why:
God said “I will make the place of my feet glorious”: what is God going to do once the foundation of the beautiful wood is laid? Revelation 21 shows it, and it is twofold. “And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.” A new heaven and a new earth: it’s going to be a change of worlds, brothers and sisters.

“And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.” That’s the twofold meaning. Adorned as a bride for a husband is talking about us, the nation of Israel, the people; but it also goes into the kingdom itself, the world.

“And had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel”: three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south and three on the west. “And the wall of the city had twelve foundations”: it’s going to be twelve foundations on New Jerusalem, “and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.”

“And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city”: he that talked with John was the angel. “And the city lieth foursquare, and the length is as large as the breadth”: it’s going to be a perfect square. “Twelve thousand furlongs” is 1500 miles. “The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal”: 1500 miles this way and that way. From New York City to Oklahoma is about 1500 miles; from New York City to south of Cuba is another 1500 miles. That’s how you know man ain’t doing it. When it says he that talked with me measured it, it’s because we can’t measure it; it’s beyond us. Only God can do that; that’s the Father.

“And he measured the wall thereof, an hundred and forty and four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of the angel.” The measure of a man is like two feet a cubit, but then it says no, not the measure of a man, the measure of an angel, and we don’t even know what the measurement of an angel is. That’s how the walls of New Jerusalem are going to be. The Lord said, the rest of it let the nations deal with that, but New Jerusalem, my kingdom, I’m going to establish this thing.

“And the building of the wall of it was of jasper: and the city was pure gold, like unto clear glass.” They didn’t do this. “And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones”: that’s why the nations are going to bring all their wealth. Jasper, sapphire, chalcedony, emerald, sardonyx, sardius, chrysolite, beryl, topaz, chrysoprasus, jacinth, amethyst: these twelve stones are what the high priest wore, as you read in Exodus, one stone representing each tribe. That’s going to be the foundation of New Jerusalem when it’s established.

“The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee” goes back to what was read earlier in Job 20: “His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.”

sense.text:
Back to Job 20 at verse 18: “That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down”: he ain’t gonna enjoy it. “According to his substance shall the restitution be”: the reparations. “And he shall not rejoice therein”: he ain’t gonna be happy about it either. Why? “Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor”: because he has oppressed and forsaken the 12 tribes of Israel.

“Because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not”: the white man builded it not.

precepts.why: The precept for the poor, as proof: “What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.” The poor of his people: the poor in Job 20:19 are God’s people of Zion.

Psalms 149:2 explains Zion: “Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.” That’s talking about the 12 tribes of Israel. Nobody else on the planet is Zion but us.

“Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.” Christ was talking about us, the poor in spirit: the 12 tribes of Israel that repent. Those are the poor that this man oppressed and forsook.

“Because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not”: “Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand. And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.”

Even a man and his heritage: he takes the nationalities of the people that he robs and steals from. That’s what he does.

Watch what Christ said, you that say you believe in the Son of God: “And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.” Who was suffering violence during the time of John the Baptist? The Israelites. So the kingdom of heaven he’s talking about is the Israelites; we’re the kingdom of heaven. And the violent took us by force in 70 A.D.

Our own church ain’t going to read this and explain it right. “The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy”. He ain’t talking about somebody stealing a Snickers bar or your sneakers; he’s talking about a major thief. That’s the white man: Rome at that time, and today the United States of America and the rest of the Caucasians. They stole this land; did they not kill the people here? Did they not destroy the minds and hearts of the people? Yes they did.

“I am come that they might have life”: Christ came that we might have life, because we were stolen from, we were killed, we were destroyed. He said, though you’ve been through all that, I’m come that you might have life, “and that they might have it more abundantly”: that you Israelites might have eternal life in the kingdom of heaven on earth, in New Jerusalem.

This is a prayer we’re supposed to pray, and Sunday school ain’t going to teach you this: “Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man”. If you don’t know by this time who that evil man is, shame on you. “Preserve me from the violent man”: those that violated our ancestors, stole the land and oppressed us.

“Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.” Whose purpose is to overthrow us. People ain’t learning the Bible correctly; we got to read the Bible with Israelite eyes, new eyes, Holy Spirit eyes.

“Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth”: let not the SPLC be established in this earth, let not the ADL be established in this earth, let not the Canary missionary group be established in this earth, O Lord. That’s the prophecy of the Bible. “Evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him”: that’s what’s going to happen prophetically.

sense.text: “Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly”: that’s why you’re going to have civil war in this country. What happened January 6 was nothing; just watch what’s going to happen in this country. You wouldn’t have protest after protest, fighting, nation against nation, person against person. “He shall not save of that which he desired”: he’s not going to save that which he desired to save.

“There shall none of his meat be left”: none of his meat that he stole. His meat is his wealth. “Therefore shall no man look for his goods”: no man’s gonna look for his goods, because it’s all going to be taken from him and given to the 12 tribes of Israel.
“In the fulness of his sufficiency”: when they say peace and safety. “He shall be in straits”: he gonna catch hell.

precepts.why: “For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child”. That is the fulness of his sufficiency, and then the straits: they gonna catch hell here in the United States of America. That’s prophecy.

sense.text: “Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations”: the terrible of the nations are terrorist groups; terrible and terrorist is the same root word. “And they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom”: they’re gonna test the wisdom of America. “And they shall defile thy brightness.”
“They shall bring thee down to the pit, and thou shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas.” The Bible is prophesying what’s going to happen here.

“Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I am God?” Will you say to the nations that slay you, look, I’m God, I’m a God? No: “but thou shalt be a man, and no God, in the hand of him that slayeth thee.”

Coming back to it: “Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord God.” Who spoke it? The Lord God.

precepts.why:
“Thou shalt be a man”: “They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms”. Everybody’s afraid of America, everybody’s scared of the big bad wolf, but the prophecy says they gonna come against this place.

This is how he made the earth to tremble and shook kingdoms: missiles and bombs. Under Barack Hussein Obama himself they bombed seven dark nations; Somalia was one of them, Yemen was another. “That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof”: look at the destruction in Yemen, the Arab cities they destroyed. That is the proof of what the Bible’s talking about.

“That opened not the house of his prisoners”: we’re the prisoners. He didn’t open his house to us.

“And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast”: put the ten horns up. You got Greece, France, Luxembourg, United Kingdom, Ireland, Belgium, Italy, Netherlands, Germany and Denmark. They got a lot more than that now, but those were the original group. “These shall hate the whore”: the United States of America. “And shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.” That’s the bombs, the explosions, the fire.

“For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will”: God has put it in the hearts of the ten common markets to fulfill his will. He’s going to change their minds and make them do his will, “and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled”: until our prophecy is fulfilled, us out teaching and preaching on the street.

“And the woman which thou sawest is that great city”: that great city is the United States of America, “which reigneth over the kings of the earth.” America rules over all the other kings of the earth. No other nation does it; it’s this place, Babylon the great.

Watch the pride and arrogance first. A man on a video says the West won’t fall: the F-15, the F-16, the F-22, the F-35, the M1 Abrams tank, the Blue Water Navy, the ICBMs; the United States could take on every country in the entire world militarily at the same time; the United States is not going to fall, not in our lifetime. All great kingdoms say that.

“The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom”. Concerning who? Edom. “We have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle”: that’s what we just read in Revelation 17. “Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.”

“The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock”: the clefts of the rock are the Caucasus Mountains of Georgia, Russia. That’s where he dwelt; that’s where the word Caucasian comes from. “Whose habitation is high”: he used to live in the mountains, the Khazars as well. “That saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?” That’s what that man just said: nobody can conquer the United States of America, we could take every country on the planet at the same time.

“Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle”: America’s national symbol is the bald eagle. “And though thou set thy nest among the stars”: when they landed on the moon, what did they say? The eagle has landed. That’s archived in history; we ain’t making nothing up. “Thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord.”

“All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border”: all the men of thy confederacy are the ten common markets, the EU. “The men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee”: that’s the prophecy. “They that eat thy bread”: they shared the wealth with America. “Have laid a wound under thee”: they laid a trap for the United States of America. “There is none understanding in him”: there’s no understanding in America. They’re going to be fooled and deceived. Verse 7 precepts with what we just read in Revelation 17.

sense.text: “In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits”: that’s what we just read about. “Every hand of the wicked shall come upon him”: all the nations, especially the ten major ones, the EU, are going to come against America.
“When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating”: that’s 1 Thessalonians 5:3, when they shall say peace and safety.

precepts.why: “He disappointeth the devices of the crafty”: all of America’s plans are going to be disappointed. “So that their hands cannot perform their enterprise”: what they plan to achieve, they’re going to fail. That’s the prophecy.

This is when Christ returns. “Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages”: the head of his villages, all the top nations, the EU. “They came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.” Who’s the poor, brothers? The Israelites.

“Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, through the heap of great waters. When I heard, my belly trembled”: He got scared when he saw this vision. “My lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble”. Habakkuk said he wished he was dead when that comes: it’s going to be such a dark and terrible day that he wanted to be at rest, not walking the earth at that time.

“When he cometh up unto the people”: he there is Christ, the Son of God, and the people are the white man, the white people. “He will invade them with his troops”: that’s what they call UFOs.

sense.text: Back at verse 23, “God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating”, and here it comes: “He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.” What is this iron weapon?

precepts.why: “Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire”. A smith used to make weapons; he made swords with fire. But that smith today is not called a smith, it’s called a scientist. “And that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.” A sword is not called a waster. The waster is the bomb: this is what wastes full populations, iron, steel, people. That is the iron weapon of Job 20:24.

A prophecy about the EU. “The great and mighty clouds shall be lifted up full of wrath, and the star, that they may make all the earth afraid, and them that dwell therein”: the star is the weapon they made, and all the earth is going to be afraid when they let loose these weapons. “And they shall pour out over every high and eminent place an horrible star”: a horrible star is an ICBM weapon.

Put Oppenheimer on the screen: he said, now I am become death, the destroyer of worlds, because they created the first nuclear explosion. Destroyer of worlds: that’s this white man, and what does the Bible call him? Death.

“Fire, and hail, and flying swords”: flying swords are missiles, brothers and sisters. “And many waters, that all fields may be full, and all rivers, with the abundance of great waters. And they shall break down the cities and walls, mountains and hills, trees of the wood, and grass of the meadows, and their corn.” And here’s the prophecy: “And they shall go stedfastly unto Babylon, and make her afraid.” They’re gonna go steadfastly to America and make her afraid.

This is to disprove what that Edomite said. “And in the passage they shall rush on the idle city, and shall destroy some portion of thy land, and consume part of thy glory, and shall return to Babylon that was destroyed.” America is going to be destroyed; it’s already written, and you can’t change this, brothers and sisters.

America’s military that’s in the oceans, their Navy, comes back, and returns to Babylon that was destroyed. Their military is not going to be destroyed; they’re still gonna be up and kicking. But this country, this land, is going to be destroyed.

sense.text: Read again from 24: “He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through. It is drawn, and cometh out of the body”. This iron weapon, the Bible says, comes out of the ground: this is called a silo. The silo opens up, and that’s what comes out of it. “Yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall”: that’s the glittering sword right there that you’re looking at. “Terrors are upon him.”

“All darkness shall be hid in his secret places”: what are his secret places? His bunkers, these underground bunkers, some of them in mountainsides. They ain’t for you and me.

“A fire not blown shall consume him”. When you light a fire, in order to get it to spread you got to blow on it. The Bible says this type of fire is not the kind you blow on; it don’t need no help, no accelerant.

“It shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle”: those that are left here in America, it’s going to go ill with them, very ill, meaning death and destruction.

precepts.why: “But I have made Esau bare”: God has made Esau bare. “I have uncovered his secret places”: these are his secret places, the bunkers. “And he shall not be able to hide himself”: he ain’t gonna be able to hide, brothers and sisters. Any secret bunkers, these secret places, the Bible prophesies they shall not be hid. “His seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he is not.” He’s going to be wiped out, eliminated.

“And they shall go into the holes of the rocks”: those are the underground bunkers, “and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty”. You don’t want none of this, little man. He gonna come back, and you’re going to be scared in your boots, “when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.”

Here’s the prophecy of the fire not blown: “For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the Lord of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.” Nobody’s going to be left. That’s prophecy that your churches ain’t gonna share with you; they probably don’t even know it.

About a fire not blown: “For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.” This place is a whole bribery; that’s how they get what they got, through bribery and stealing.

“The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish”: the Lord don’t want none of us to perish. So you men and women that stumble in this truth, you stumble in your sin, get back up and come back in this truth. Repent. “But that all should come to repentance”: he wants all of us to come to repentance.

“But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise”: that noise is the thermonuclear explosion. “And the elements shall melt with fervent heat”: the elements, that’s your iron, your steel. “The earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.”

“Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be”: what manner of persons are we Israelites to be? “In all holy conversation and godliness, Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat”.

“It shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle”: “Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire”. America shall be utterly burned with fire, thus saith the Lord. “For strong is the Lord God who judgeth her”: it’s not us judging her, it’s the Lord of heaven and earth that nobody wants to hear.

“And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her”: all nations got wealthy doing business with the United States of America. They “shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning, Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.” It’s only going to take the Lord one hour to have this place destroyed; he’s going to have those nations come here and destroy it in one hour, with all that technology.

“And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more”.

sense.text: “The heaven shall reveal his iniquity”: who’s revealing the iniquity of this man? The teachers. You brothers that teach, you’re revealing the iniquity of this man. “And the earth shall rise up against him.”
“The increase of his house shall depart”: the riches of his house shall depart, “and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath”: in the day of God’s wrath.

“This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God.” This is his portion from God, brothers and sisters. You can’t change the written prophecies. So brothers, never give up.

precepts.why: About the heaven shall reveal his iniquity: “And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth”. The spirit of his mouth means the Bible: the Bible is the mouth of God. And the Lord ain’t coming down here doing the teaching, doing the rebuking; it’s you men. That’s why it behooves you to learn your book, it behooves you to learn your records, it behooves you to learn the prophecies, and it behooves us all to keep the commandments.

“Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.” That’s the prophecy. So whatever we find out that’s true, if it coincides with the Bible, we’re to teach it, we’re to preach it, we’re to bring it out.

“What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light”: Christ said the mysteries that I tell you in darkness, I want you to go out in the light and teach it to everybody. “And what ye hear in the ear”, what you have been taught in your ear, “that preach ye upon the housetops.”

“And fear not them which kill the body”: why does he say that? Because what we’re going to preach is going to get us killed. That’s what the FBI is about, that’s what the ADL is about, the SPLC, the Canary missionary. “But are not able to kill the soul”: they gonna kill some of your bodies, but don’t worry, they can kill none of your souls. “But rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.” That’s the message to brothers that don’t want to do what this Bible says because you’re scared. It says you better fear him. You want to be rebellious and go against what he says, he gonna kill your body and your soul in hell: that’s the lake of fire.
